Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

Line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.card: Line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: 8 hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Pehle 7 gaps the, ab zyada hain, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se theek ek gap door. Yahan tak saaf hai?
drawing karke samjhao

Dhyan pehle hisse par rakho: pehli patti aath barabar hisson mein hai aur uska pehla hissa rangin hai, doosri utni hi lambi patti das barabar hisson mein. Dono pattiyon ka baayan kinaara line ka 0 hai. Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/8 sahi nahi hai. Chalo, isko ek aur dhang se samajhte hain. Board par ek line hai: line ke dono taraf ke gap 0 se 1 ka wahi ek poora baant-te hain. Fraction ka neeche wala number jitna bada, utne zyada barabar gaps, aur har gap utna chhota. Bada number matlab bada gap nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?

seams.form: Chalo, isko ek aur dhang se samajhte hain.

director.text: haan
Line ke neeche 7 gaps hain, aur line ke upar pehla mark 1/5 hai. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya baad mein?

5 gap milkar 0 se 1 bharte hain, aur 7 gap ko bhi wahi 0 se 1 bharna hai, toh 7 waala har gap chhota hoga; isliye 1/7 pehle aata hai, 0 aur 1/5 ke beech. Ab tak samajh aaya?

director.text: 1 by 10

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre door hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
yeh step samajh nahi aaya
Agar school aur door hota, toh line aur lambi kheenchte. Yahan raasta theek 1 kilometre ka hai, isliye line 0 se 1 tak, aur yahi humara ek poora hai. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
phir bhi samajh nahi aaya

Socho tum ghar se school ja rahe ho, raasta 1 kilometre ka. Raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe aise lage hain ki ghar, teeno khambe aur school, sab ek-doosre se barabar doori par hain. Pehla khamba kitni door milega, yahi nikalna hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao

Pehle chhota socho: beech mein sirf 1 khamba hota, toh woh theek aadhe raaste par, 1/2 kilometre par hota. Ab 3 khambe hain, toh pehle yeh dekho ki woh raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein baant-te hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Theek hai, aise sawaal hum aage phir karenge, tab saath mein dekhenge. Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada. Ab tak samajh aaya?

seams.form: Theek hai, aise sawaal hum aage phir karenge, tab saath mein dekhenge.

director.text: haan
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/4 kilometre

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
mujhe nahi pata
4 barabar gaps milkar poora 1 kilometre banate hain, toh ek gap 1 kilometre ka ek chauthai hai, yaani 1/4 kilometre. Yahan tak saaf hai?
haan

batting

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne. Yahan tak saaf hai?
